typed public custody versus exact player-visible prose parity

nonclaims: A fresh continuation dispatch is local host custody, not proof that a provider erased memory, denied tools, or isolated a worker.
Public history contains only the committed turn runs explicitly supplied; it does not prove transcript completeness or absence of selective omission.
Exact player-visible prose and digests do not make every semantic implication a typed assertion or mechanically enforced canon.
A parent or provider can still inject extra information outside the validated dispatch.
Run IDs plus packet and receipt digests remain sidecar custody and require retained run directories for independent re-audit.
The compressed state card remains private planning guidance, not player-observed truth.
Passing schemas, audits, and receipts do not prove narrative quality, model identity, rater independence, or retcon-planning efficacy.
Database schema 8 and event schema 1 remain unchanged; public history and continuation dispatches are private host/exchange artifacts.
acceptance_note: Rev0164 closes the source-bound handoff from an accepted checkpoint into the first genuinely fresh ordinary narration turn and makes exact pre-checkpoint public prose optionally auditable without widening narrator authority.
